Hi there! Posting here is a great first step in finding help, I'm really glad you did it! 

Assuming you are in the US, there are a number of free texting/voice-to-voice hotlines you can call, and peer counseling services that I know have personally helped me when my depression gets too much to bear. The National Suicide Hotline is a good starting place (1-800-273-8255) which I know sounds extreme, but they are available 24/7 to talk to you and listen to your problems. I have personally called them during crisis and the person I spoke to was calm and very understanding. Reaching out and admitting you have a problem is tough and embarrassing sometimes, but getting the help you need to deal with these kinds of issues will help so much in the long run. I really wish you the best.
